tieu_de: Auto/ Manual QA Engineer Salary upto 2500 /month
mo_ta_cong_viec:
WELCOME TO INGENICO
Payments happen everywhere. In shops, on busy streets, and across countless digital touchpoints. In many of these everyday moments, Ingenico quietly powers the way customers pay.
As a global leader in payment acceptance, we make transactions simple, secure, and seamless for millions of people worldwide.
With operations in more than 30 countries and over 4,000 experts, we have spent more than 45 years shaping the future of commerce. Guided by trust, innovation and care, we build technology that moves payments. 
ABOUT THE JOB
Ingenico Android Competence Center (ACC) is responsible for building and maintaining Android-based payment software used across multiple regions worldwide. 
We are looking for 2 QA Engineers (1 Auto, 1 Manual) to join our growing QA team in Hanoi. Whether your expertise is in Manual Testing, Test Automation, or both, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, stability, and reliability of Android and Web applications delivered to global customers.
You will collaborate with Project Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, Scrum Masters, and QA professionals in an international Agile environment while contributing to product quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
 
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Analyze requirements and create test cases, test plans, and test data.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and release testing for Android/Web applications.
Report, track, and verify defects with development teams.
Collaborate with PMs, BAs, Developers, and global stakeholders.
Perform exploratory and end-to-end testing.
Support release validation and product quality improvement initiatives.
Mentor junior QA engineers.For Manual QA
Define test strategy and estimate testing effort.
Perform exploratory and end-to-end testing.
Track QA metrics and support release sign-off.For Automation QA
Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts.
Identify automation opportunities and improve test coverage.
Contribute to automation frameworks and reusable components.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
Analyze automation results and optimize automation effectiveness.
yeu_cau:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or related fields.
Minimum 3 years of experience in Software Testing/QA.
Experience testing Android and/or Web applications.
Good understanding of software testing methodologies and Agile practices.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Fluent English communication.For Manual QA
Strong experience in functional, regression, integration, and release testing.
Experience creating test plans and test strategies.
Experience with test management and defect tracking tools.
Automation knowledge is a plus.
Can lead the small team (3 -5 QA) is an advantageFor Automation QA
Hands-on experience with automation testing for Android and/or Web.
Experience with Selenium, Appium, UI Automator2, or similar tools.
Experience with Robot Framework, Cypress, Katalon, Serenity, or equivalent frameworks.
Programming experience in Python.
Understanding of POM, BDD, TDD, and Data-Driven Testing.
CI/CD experience is a plus.
quyen_loi:
Work life balance & no OT

WHAT WE OFFER AT INGENICO
At Ingenico, we believe our people are our greatest asset. We offer a rewarding package designed to support your career growth, wellbeing, and work-life balance:
Competitive salary package with full statutory social insurance coverage and Premium Healthcare Insurance for you and your family.
Monday to Friday working schedule.
Opportunity to work in a global organization and collaborate with talented colleagues from diverse cultural backgrounds across different countries.
Strong focus on employee wellbeing with 15 annual leave days and a supportive, people-centric culture.
Modern Grade A office located in Duy Tan, Hanoi, equipped with employee-friendly amenities and collaborative workspaces.
A dynamic and innovative environment where you can learn, grow, and make an impact in the future of payments technology.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION AND BELONGING
As part of our values, we embrace diversity and inclusion at Ingenico. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.
Accommodation is available on request throughout the recruitment process. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.
Please note: We are currently accepting applications from Vietnamese candidates only.
We look forward to connecting with talented professionals who are excited to grow their careers in a global environment at Ingenico.
